Penalty

  1. Ten penalties. Flick from anywhere towards the goal: the direction and length of the flick pick the spot, shown by the ring on the goal.
  2. Flick faster to hit it harder. Hard shots are harder to save but stray more, so tight corners get risky.
  3. Bend the flick to curl the ball. The keeper reads the ball's first line, so a curl can send him the wrong way.
  4. Sometimes he guesses a side early. Every goal makes him a little quicker.
  5. On a keyboard: arrow keys move the target, hold space for power and let go.
